steps.objective: Decompose the mission intent into slices (one buildable user outcome each, disjoint file territories), record depends_on edges, the wave map and a gate tier per slice, scaffold slice.yaml files, and export the compiled graph to docs/evidence/<mission>/compiled-graph.json.

Independent review of the decomposition before the human sees it: slices are single buildable outcomes with disjoint territories, dependencies and waves are consistent with the intent, gate tiers are justified, risks are named. Rework goes back to the planner by queue handoff while this step waits; a clean review hands off.
Hold the decomposition at the human gate: slices, order, waves, gate tiers and risks as a decision brief. On approval record the mission plan-lock stamp on behalf of the human.

gate.summary: Mission decomposition ready — approve slices, waves and gate tiers (mission plan-lock).

steps.objective: For each wave in order: instantiate one urlshort-slice workflow per slice (fan-out), wait on every slice's proof (fan-in), merge accepted candidates serially into main, roll back by revert when main goes red.

Review the accumulated wave range on main with two vantages (review agent + design agent, authors excluded): drift against the SPECs, structure, and claim-by-claim verification; dispose misses as CONTEXT-GAP or JUDGMENT-GAP.

Prepare the release: build the jar and image, run the installed smoke journey, update README/TESTING, write RELEASE.md with evidence links and known gaps, export evidence and refresh metrics. Publish nothing.

Independent review of the release package before the human ship gate: every claim in RELEASE.md traced to evidence (proof readiness, review verdicts, coverage, smoke), known gaps complete and honest, rollback path real. Rework goes back to the release agent by queue handoff while this step waits; a clean review hands off.
Hold the ship decision at the human gate against RELEASE.md. Approval records delivery stamps for the mission's slices; nothing is published by an agent.

gate.summary: Release candidate prepared and proven — sign off to ship (publishing stays a human act).
